title: Uniform upper bound for unbounded quasi-coherent space pushforward
statement: Work in the fixed universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ with their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], quasi-coherence [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], and the canonical module direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Suppose $f$ is quasi-compact (its pullback by every affine scheme over $Y$ has quasi-compact source) and quasi-separated (its relative diagonal is quasi-compact). Assume also that $Y$ is quasi-compact. In the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], compute $Rf_*$ using K-injective resolutions, where a complex $I$ is K-injective if every map from an acyclic complex to $I$ is null-homotopic. Then there exists an integer $N\geq1$, depending only on $f$, such that for every integer $b$ and every $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ with quasi-coherent cohomology and $H^q(E)=0$ for $q>b$, one has $H^m(Rf_*E)=0$ for all $m\geq b+N$. No lower bound on $E$ and no Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Choose $N\geq1$ from [lem-sfb-space-affine-chart-uniform-qcoh-vanishing]. For every affine etale $V\to Y$, this gives $R^pF_V(M)=0$ for all quasi-coherent $M$ and $p\geq N$, with the same $N$ for every $V$. Here $F_V$ is evaluation at $W=X\times_YV$ after extending to $\mathcal C_X$. It is left exact and commutes with countable products: kernels and products of module sheaves are computed sectionwise (the sheaf condition glues each component), evaluation preserves these operations, and the extension equivalence preserves their universal properties. Thus $F_V$ meets the functor hypotheses of 08F7.

source.place: Tag 08FA, proof of (2), choice of N and the functor Gamma(V times_Y X, -).

proof.text: Fix $b$ and $E$ as in the statement. Apply [lem-sfb-space-product-preserving-derived-functor-upper-bound] on $X$ with the functor $F_V$ and the uniform integer $N$ from step 1. Its hypotheses concern exactly quasi-coherent modules and the cohomology of $E$, not the individual terms of a representative. It yields $H^m(RF_V(E))=0$ for every $m\geq b+N$ and every affine etale $V\to Y$, with no lower bound on $E$.

source.place: Tag 08FA, proof of (2), application of Tag 08F7(3), with general upper endpoint b.

proof.text: Use [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]: $v_f:\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal C_X$ sends $V$ to $X\times_YV$ and induces the ringed morphism for $f$. By [lem-trf-space-chart-limit-enlarged-sections], its module direct image transported to the small sites is canonically the specified chart-limit direct image. Applying [lem-sfb-ringed-site-unbounded-leray-sections] therefore gives $R\Gamma(V,Rf_*E)\cong RF_V(E)$ in $D(\operatorname{Ab})$. The extension equivalences transport K-injective resolutions, since they preserve acyclic complexes, homotopies and maps. Taking degree $m\geq b+N$ cohomology gives $H^m(R\Gamma(V,Rf_*E))=0$. Choose a K-injective representative $J$ of $Rf_*E$ using [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], applicable to the small ringed site of $Y$ in the fixed universe.

source.place: Tag 08FA, proof of (2), derived sections comparison; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0D6H.

proof.text: Use the representative $J$ chosen in step 3. On every affine etale $V\to Y$, the complex $J(V)$ computes $R\Gamma(V,Rf_*E)$; hence each degree-$m$ cycle in $J(V)$ is a boundary. Every scheme object of $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$ has its affine open covering. Kernels are sectionwise and cokernels are sheafified sectionwise cokernels, so $H^m(J)$ is locally represented by these cycle classes, all zero. Thus $H^m(Rf_*E)=0$ for all $m\geq b+N$.

lean.statement: theorem derivedDirectImage_uniform_upper_bound {S : Scheme.{u}} {X Y : AlgebraicSpace S} (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.SmallModules] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} Y.SmallModules] (hqc : IsQuasiCompactPresheafMap f.hom.hom) (hqs : IsQuasiCompactPresheafMap (diagonalPresheafMap f.hom.hom)) (hY : CompactSpace (Point Y.obj.obj)) : ∃ N : ℤ, 1 ≤ N ∧ ∀ (b : ℤ) (E : X.DerivedModules), X.derivedQCohProperty E → (∀ q : ℤ, b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules q).obj E)) → ∀ m : ℤ, b + N ≤ m → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Y.SmallModules m).obj ((derivedDirectImage f).obj E))
